polls.description: Major semiconductor partnerships and investments as tech giants race to secure AI chip supply chains, with deals totaling hundreds of billions.

cluster_stories.title: South Korea's SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics sign $950 billion partnership with US big tech
cluster_stories.summary: The partnership includes the long-term supply of $750 ​billion in memory ​chips to US companies by SK Hynix ‌and $200 billion in chips ​by Samsung ​Electronics ⁠to Broadcom, the presidential adviser, Kim Yong-beom, ​said at a briefing.
cluster_stories.headline: SAMSUNG AND SK HYNIX SIGN $950B DEAL With US Big Tech

cluster_stories.title: Samsung signs a $200 billion chip deal with Broadcom covering memory, foundry and advanced packaging through 2030
cluster_stories.summary: Samsung Electronics and Broadcom have signed a memorandum of understanding worth more than $200 billion spanning memory chips, foundry manufacturing and advanced packaging for artificial intelligence semiconductors. The deal, announced on Friday at an AI summit in San Francisco, runs for five years through 2030 and covers some of the most critical layers of the […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: SAMSUNG SIGNS $200B CHIP DEAL With Broadcom... AI Foundry Push

cluster_stories.title: Samsung Electronics wins $200 billion Broadcom AI chip partnership, boosting foundry push
cluster_stories.summary: The tie-up comes as global technology companies increasingly develop their own custom ​AI accelerators, rather than relying solely on ⁠general-purpose graphics processors, ‌driving demand for specialised chip design and manufacturing ​partnerships. The next five years of collaboration will combine Broadcom's expertise in designing application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), or chips for specific tasks, with Samsung's manufacturing capabilities.
cluster_stories.headline: Samsung Wins $200B Broadcom AI Chip Partnership Through 2030

cluster_stories.title: SK Chair Says Anthropic Asked for Supplies to Make Its Own Chips
cluster_stories.summary: AI developer Anthropic PBC has asked SK Hynix Inc., one of the world’s biggest manufacturers of memory chips, for supplies to make its own semiconductors, SK Group Chairman Chey Tae Won said.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC ASKS SK HYNIX FOR CHIP-MAKING SUPPLIES

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia, SK Group unveil $500 billion-plus AI data centres initiative, memory partnership
cluster_stories.summary: As part ⁠of the initiative, SK Telecom plans ​to build a 2-gigawatt ​AI data centre powered by Nvidia's Vera Rubin chips and SK Hynix's HBM4 high-bandwidth memory, with the ‌first facility due to come online in 2027, ​Nvidia added.
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA, SK GROUP UNVEIL $500B+ AI DATA CENTER BLITZ

cluster_stories.title: AMD is investing $5 billion in Anthropic and deploying 2 gigawatts of Helios GPUs to run Claude
cluster_stories.summary: AMD and Anthropic announced a strategic partnership on Tuesday that commits AMD to invest up to $5 billion in Anthropic and deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs in Helios rackscale solutions to run Claude. Deployment of the first gigawatt begins in the first half of 2027. Anthropic is already using […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: AMD INVESTS $5B IN ANTHROPIC... 2GW GPU DEPLOYMENT

cluster_stories.title: Samsung in talks to invest in Mistral at €20bn valuation
cluster_stories.summary: South Korean giant could invest as much as €1bn in French AI group seeking to be a leading alternative to US tech
cluster_stories.headline: SAMSUNG TO POUR €1BN INTO MISTRAL AI AT €20BN VALUATION

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia is pouring $1 billion into South Korea’s AI infrastructure through Naver and SK Group
cluster_stories.summary: Nvidia will invest $1 billion in South Korean internet company Naver to help finance an AI data center under construction in South Korea, the chipmaker announced late Friday. The funding will allow Naver to more than triple the size of the facility from 55 megawatts to 200 megawatts, with US private equity firm Brookfield agreeing […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA Pours $1B Into South Korea AI... Naver Data Center Deal

cluster_stories.title: Samsung Inks $200 Billion Chip Supply with Broadcom
cluster_stories.summary: Samsung Electronics Co. won a contract worth more than $200 billion to make chips for Broadcom Inc., as the companies race to win a larger share of the AI infrastructure market.
cluster_stories.headline: SAMSUNG LANDS $200B CHIP DEAL WITH BROADCOM FOR AI

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia to Invest $1 Billion in Naver and Expand SK Group Accord
cluster_stories.summary: Nvidia Corp. will invest $1 billion in Naver Corp. to help finance an AI data center under construction in South Korea, adding to a frenzy of deals by the world’s most valuable company.
cluster_stories.headline: Nvidia Pumps $1B Into Korean AI Data Center

cluster_stories.title: AMD to invest up to $5 billion in Anthropic; AI startup to buy up to 2 GW of chips
cluster_stories.summary: AMD has been ​seeking to expand its foothold in the fast-growing ​AI chip market as developers look to diversify beyond Nvidia, while Anthropic has ​been racing to secure ⁠computing capacity ‌to meet growing demand for ​its ​AI services.
cluster_stories.headline: AMD TO INVEST $5 BILLION IN ANTHROPIC

cluster_stories.summary: Article URL: https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1292/amd-and-anthropic-announce-strategic-partnership-to-deploy-up-to-2-gigawatts-of-amd-instinct-mi450-series-gpus Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49010643 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

polls.description: China's advancement in domestic chipmaking technology, particularly DUV tools rivaling ASML, is disrupting global semiconductor markets and intensifying US-China tech competition.
polls.question: Is China's chipmaking breakthrough a threat or opportunity for global tech?

cluster_stories.title: China begins making homegrown DUV chipmaking tools: The Information
cluster_stories.summary: The machines are expected to be delivered this year to leading ‌Chinese chipmakers, ⁠including ⁠Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corp, Hua Hong Semiconductor and ChangXin Memory ​Technologies, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BEGINS MASS-PRODUCING HOMEGROWN DUV CHIPMAKING TOOLS

cluster_stories.title: China DUV Chipmaking: How Machine Advances Could Reduce Reliance on ASML, Nvidia
cluster_stories.summary: China’s semiconductor industry may have achieved a breakthrough in building chipmaking machines that have long been dominated by the Netherlands’ ASML Holding NV. A state-backed firm in Shanghai has found a way to make so-called immersion deep ultraviolet lithography tools that are capable of manufacturing the most widely used chips, according to the Information.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BREAKTHROUGH: State Firm Builds Chipmaking Machine Rivaling ASML

cluster_stories.title: ASML shares fell 6.5% after a report that China has started mass-producing DUV lithography tools
cluster_stories.summary: ASML shares fell as much as 6.5% in Amsterdam on Monday after The Information reported that a Shanghai-based company has begun mass-producing immersion deep ultraviolet lithography tools. The machines are the type that ASML has been restricted from selling to China under Dutch and US export controls. If the report is accurate, it represents exactly […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA MASS-PRODUCES DUV CHIPS... ASML TANKS 6.5%

cluster_stories.title: China's chip tool push shows ASML caught in US-China squeeze
cluster_stories.summary: On the one hand, US controls on exports of high-tech ​goods to China are threatening to reduce access to a major market; and on the other, Beijing's push for technological independence in areas such as chip production raises the possibility of a China-based competitor.
cluster_stories.headline: ASML Caught in US-China Chip War Crossfire

cluster_stories.title: Chinese chip champion CXMT soars more than 500% in market debut
cluster_stories.summary: Tech group becomes China’s most valuable listed company in mainland’s biggest IPO since 2010
cluster_stories.headline: CHINESE CHIP MAKER CXMT SOARS 500% IN MASSIVE IPO

cluster_stories.title: ASML Slides on Report of China Starting DUV Tool Production
cluster_stories.summary: ASML Holding NV shares slid to the lowest since early June after a report that a Chinese state-backed company has begun mass producing certain chipmaking machines, posing a potential threat to the Dutch firm’s sales.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA STARTS DUV CHIPMAKING TOOL PRODUCTION... ASML Slides
